messages:
alex: quick profiling ask — seeing ~15% p99 regression on generation for batch=32 on rtx nodes. Can someone run a short nsys + torch.prof smoke capture (warmup + 1 infer step) and drop traces to the perf bucket? Model: redwood/3b-infer@v2, seq_len=1024, kv-cache ON. No long runs — just reproduce at B=32 on 1 GPU.

priya: I can take this. Will capture nsys + torch.prof. Do you want nvtx ranges around warmup/infer and memory sampling?

alex: yep, nvtx warmup + infer ranges please. Capture peak mem and kernel stalls if possible. Link the raw .nsys and pt.trace.

priya: here are the quick commands I usually run for a smoke capture — minimal and deterministic.

priya: ```bash
# nsys quick smoke capture (overwrite if exists)
NSYS_OUT=/tmp/trace_2612345678
nsys profile -o "$NSYS_OUT" --trace=cuda,cublas,cudnn,osrt --capture-range=nvtx --force-overwrite --sample=none --cpuctxsw=false \
  python -u run_infer.py --model redwood/3b-infer@v2 --seq-len 1024 --batch 32 --steps 2
```

priya: and a tiny torch.profiler wrapper to emit a tensorboard/trace file you can open with profiler or convert to chrome trace.

priya: ```python
from torch.profiler import profile, ProfilerActivity, schedule, tensorboard_trace_handler
with profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
             schedule=schedule(wait=0, warmup=1, active=1),
             on_trace_ready=tensorboard_trace_handler('/tmp/pt_trace'),
             record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True) as p:
    for _ in range(3):
        outputs = model.generate(input_ids, max_new_tokens=8)
        p.step()
```

chen: couple of quick notes: set CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0 for non-blocking behavior. If you want KV-specific breakdowns, add TORCH_PROFILER_RECORD_KV=true (our small patch picks up kv ops). Also attach the model gitsha if possible.

marta: I can scrub and upload once priya has artifacts. Reminder: remove any customer prompts and any hostnames/IPs. Simple redaction one-liner below (ad-hoc):

marta: ```bash
# redact urls/ips/paths from human-readable traces
sed -E -e 's#(https?://)[^\\s]*/#\\1[REDACTED]/#g' -e 's#([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}#REDACTED_IP#g' trace.nsys > trace_redacted.nsys
```

perf-bot: note: upload accepted. Artifacts will appear at https://perf.internal/redwood/2612345678/ once processing completes. Use perf-viewer to open flamegraphs and chrome traces.

alex: thanks — if anyone hits noise or large files, ping me. priya/marta: please paste the upload links here once available and I'll start the flamegraph triage + plan a tiny bisect if we see kernel regressions.
